description: This file contains implementation code for initializing and processing multiboot information during the early boot process on x86 architecture within the Zephyr RTOS. It handles memory map parsing and setup based on multiboot data provided by the bootloader.

methods.name: clear_memmap
methods.description: Clears or resets the memory map entries starting from a given index.

methods.name: z_multiboot_init
methods.description: Initializes the multiboot information structure, processes memory maps, and sets up memory regions based on bootloader data.
